explication: AnyPS5 ports executables to native Linux and Windows formats, then supplies system-library implementations for dynamic linking rather than using a separate emulation process. The main workflow is executable input through relinker analysis and patching to a native executable; runtime compatibility is provided by PRX libraries, with the AGC driver and shader recompiler supporting graphics execution. The README also documents controller and configurable keyboard/mouse input. Several implementation links are dashed because the relevant source was not sampled.
